title: Schedules, indexes, properties and quantity workflows
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product with deterministic schedules, indexes, property-driven reporting and quantity workflows, using the Construction Graph as the authoritative information source and preserving frozen ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule and index definitions are document-owned, deterministic and persist through save/open/replay.
Property-driven fields resolve from canonical model/Construction Graph semantics without a parallel source of truth.
Quantity workflows derive from canonical geometry/component/material semantics and remain revision-bound and reproducible.
Filters, grouping, sorting, calculated fields and presentation remain deterministic and explicitly typed where unsupported.
Web and Electron share the same semantic schedule/index/property/quantity contracts.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..014 and COMPAT baselines remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is required.
Real engine/toolchain behavior remains behind existing adapter/worker boundaries.
Exact final head must be CI-verified, deployment/browser/Electron verified where applicable, and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: 4D/5D enterprise planning beyond the bounded quantity semantics required here.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-014 is VERIFIED and is the current interoperability baseline.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is VERIFIED and remains the BIM information baseline.
COMPAT-CAD-003 remains available as the documentation/quantity baseline.
COMPAT-IFC-001 remains available for exchange-backed property semantics.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P015.
evidence_requirements: Representative Web/Electron parity fixtures for schedule and quantity workflows.
Canonical Construction Graph/property lineage checks demonstrating no parallel source of truth.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..014 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Release CAD-PARITY-015 as the next bounded schedules, indexes, properties and quantity slice following verified interoperability.
All declared P015 dependencies are verified on main. Assign implementation to the logical implementation agent and require stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.

Scope is the bounded deterministic schedules, indexes, property-driven reporting and quantity workflows defined by Issue #110, preserving Construction Graph authority, shared Web/Electron semantics, adapter/worker boundaries and the PR_OPEN/VERIFYING stop gate.

The CAD-PARITY-015 implementation is complete and submitted as PR #111 (three phased commits on the rebased mainline: P1 the shared core f8a1555→28b703b — the prd-NNNNNN property-definition registry with the canonical-overlay lineage statistics, the schedules engine powers (pd: columns, property-driven conditions, deterministic multi-key sort, bounded calculated fields, grouping with subtotals/grand totals, presentation format), and the revision-bound closed-form quantity takeoff with the material BOM; P2 the web surface 06701cc→0c35210 — the Schedules workbench + the transport mirrors + the report.properties/report.quantities command-line actions; P3 the evidence layer 0028659→566a4e1 — the schedules-p015 smoke (25 app-api calls), the pinned cad-parity-015-schedules fixture and the cad-parity-015 CI workflow). Evidence: EV-001 the deterministic implementation suite (1215/1215 app tests with the pinned IFC toolchain, 18 new P015 tests; tsc/lint/build green), EV-002 the thirteen-smoke web chain with the twelve prior parity fixtures byte-identical and the NEW pinned fixture matching across fresh server restarts, EV-003 the governance gates (validate 426/426, check-protected PASS, check-verified-revisions PASS). The branch was rebased onto main (68a0c6e) to resolve the parallel work-item registration conflict, keeping the canonical IMPLEMENTING record.

Submit CAD-PARITY-015 (PR #111) for Architect review with the exact-head CI evidence (EV-004): the cad-parity-015 workflow run 33524551513 on the exact head ec8e01f — ALL THREE jobs green (the Workspace deterministic suite with the full 1215-test app suite incl. the 18 new P015 tests, the Web host with ALL THIRTEEN parity smokes incl. the pinned CAD-PARITY-015 fixture, and the Electron host build + 18 smokes) — plus the full 24-workflow path-filter regression matrix on the same head (19+ completed success at submission, the remainder draining green; the pull_request event pipeline had stalled during a GitHub-service degradation at submission time — five trigger attempts are documented in the record, and a disclosed workflow_dispatch arm was added to cad-parity-015.yml as the recoverable trigger whose dispatch produced the bound run). Local revision-bound evidence: EV-001 the implementation suite, EV-002 the thirteen-smoke chain with the pinned fixtures, EV-003 the governance gates. Stops at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING per the workflow lock — no merge, no VERIFIED claim.

CHANGES REQUESTED on CAD-PARITY-015 (PR #111) — the Architect decision relayed through the operator session: the repository-side evidence is strong (the exact head fc8ea4c is covered by the full 24-workflow matrix including the dedicated P015 workspace/Web/Electron jobs; the governance, protected-path and verified-revision gates pass; the P015 smoke and fixture are deterministic; the deployed standalone build was browser-tested through the sandbox gateway), but the same blocking requirement remains unmet — the exact-head VERCEL deployment with revision-bound real-browser evidence. The sandbox gateway/standalone deployment (EV-005) is not equivalent to the Vercel evidence standard established for P012-P014: a browser session against a locally controlled production server, even exposed through Caddy, does not prove the exact GitHub revision was built and served by the production Vercel project. The inherited P014 production-build 1-ULP issue does not by itself block P015 approval (isolated to an untouched P014 file, honestly disclosed). No merge, no VERIFIED, no P016 release until the remediation lands.
